summary: Sporting News columnist Sloan Piva presents his Week 9 2023 NFL best bets across spreads, moneylines, over/unders and SuperDraft player props, using odds from Caesars Sportsbook. He admits a rough two-week stretch but says the season record is still 65-46-1. Headline picks are the Colts to cover against the Panthers and the Dolphins to upset the Chiefs in Frankfurt.
one_line: Sloan Piva's Week 9 2023 NFL best bets feature Colts over Panthers, Dolphins upsetting Chiefs in Germany, a Raiders-Giants under, and three receiving-yard props.
key_facts: Piva's best bets are 65-46-1 on the season, a winning percentage of over .590, after going 5-6 in Week 7 and 6-8 in Week 8.
Last week's ATS picks went 1-3, player props went 0-3, and moneyline and over/under picks went 5-2.
Colts (-2.5) at Panthers: predicted score Colts 27, Panthers 17; Carolina is 1-7 and has allowed the most rushing TDs (14), 28.4 points per game and 139.4 rushing yards per game.
Seahawks (+6) at Ravens: predicted score Ravens 26, Seahawks 23; Baltimore is 6-2 and Seattle has won two straight and is 2-1 on the road.
Dolphins (+110) vs. Chiefs in Germany: predicted score Dolphins 26, Chiefs 24; Kansas City had five turnovers and three sacks in its loss to the Broncos.
The Dolphins flew overnight on Monday to Frankfurt, while the Chiefs waited until after Thursday practice for the 11-hour trip.
Raheem Mostert leads the NFL with 10 TDs and is second in yards per carry (5.4) behind Breece Hall; the Chiefs have allowed 135.6 rushing yards per game over the past three weeks.
Raiders vs. Giants UNDER 37.5 is the over/under pick, predicted score Raiders 17, Giants 13; the Raiders fired their head coach and GM and demoted Jimmy Garoppolo.
Rashee Rice OVER 45.5 receiving yards (Chiefs vs. Dolphins): he has averaged over 55 receiving yards per game over the past month, and Miami has allowed the fifth-most receptions to wideouts.
Austin Ekeler OVER 29.5 receiving yards (Chargers at Jets): he had 123 yards and a TD against the Bears, 94 through the air, and the Jets allow 46 receiving yards per game to RBs (sixth-most).
Jahan Dotson OVER 45.5 receiving yards (Commanders at Patriots): he caught 8-of-10 targets for 108 yards and a TD last week and had five catches for 43 yards in Week 7.
Other spreads: Patriots (-3) vs. Commanders and Raiders -1.5 vs. Giants; other moneylines: Vikings (+170), Bengals (-130), Cowboys (+140).
